condition.name: REP
condition.role: same live plant, second actual task after first complete H150; exposed W2 prefix, not holdout

first_task: frozen H150, same original legal prefix
second_task: persistent state then same-parent B/H150/MEMORY forks, all full TASK
state_carryover: original session_context and advance_inter_rep_boundary; no physical clock/qpos/qvel reset
feedback: first task measured force integral and live RETURN2 causal state only; native truth and matched-B future metrics excluded
online_update: one action-specific kernel coefficient for H150 =0.5*(measured full force integral - prior absolute value prediction), clipped to +/-LOO absolute prediction error; kernel exp(-0.5 mean standardized state distance squared)
guard: original predicted motion buffers + absolute-value LOO force uncertainty; H150 if unsupported or no confidence
required_for_few_repetition_pass: actual feedback update, different useful next action, complete qualified improvement over fixed H150 at same continued state; otherwise NOT_DEMONSTRATED
